# Daily Research

> A Japanese morning discovery edition: isolated Claude Opus exploration followed by fresh Opus editorial research and selection. A short reader profile guides discovery; project repositories and accumulated playbooks are not loaded. Validated JSON becomes an Obsidian note.

- [Full reference](llms-full.txt): runtime boundaries and output behavior
